def dijkstra(player_cells: Set[Tuple[int,int]], opp_cells: Set[Tuple[int,int]], is_black: bool) -> int:
    # Returns shortest path length for player to win
    dist = [[INF]*SIZE for _ in range(SIZE)]
    pq = []
    
    if is_black:
        # Sources: row 0
        for c in range(SIZE):
            if (0, c) in opp_cells:
                continue
            cost = 0 if (0, c) in player_cells else 1
            dist[0][c] = cost
            heapq.heappush(pq, (cost, 0, c))
        
        while pq:
            d, r, c = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if d != dist[r][c]:
                continue
            if r == SIZE - 1:  # Reached bottom
                return d
            for nr, nc in neighbors(r, c):
                if (nr, nc) in opp_cells:
                    continue
                nd = d + (0 if (nr, nc) in player_cells else 1)
                if nd < dist[nr][nc]:
                    dist[nr][nc] = nd
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, nr, nc))
    else:
        # White: connect col 0 to col 10
        for r in range(SIZE):
            if (r, 0) in opp_cells:
                continue
            cost = 0 if (r, 0) in player_cells else 1
            dist[r][0] = cost
            heapq.heappush(pq, (cost, r, 0))

    return INF
